note: Context-free readings for the spoken layer (say). `map`: lowercased 1697 form -> modern form, one WORD_RE token each; proposed by glossers, checked by reviewers and by the speech-lexicon gate (hunspell fr_FR plus properNouns). `symbols`: printed characters that are spoken but are not WORD_RE tokens. `wordClipReadings`: how a glossary key that is an elided fragment is read in its own word clip. See claude/french-perrault-conventions.md §3.
